outcome: Units of pack red blood cells transfused
cohort: 255 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
finding: Planned cesarean delivery in patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders was associated with a lower need for blood transfusion and better neonatal outcomes compared to emergent cesarean delivery.
gest_age: 35.1 ± 0.27 weeks for the emergent group and 38.0 ± 0.10 weeks for the planned group
birth_weight: Higher in the planned delivery group
